house-crow/first_meet.text: [caws] Gossip the Crow! Grey shawl, sharp memory. I remember faces, so be nice to me.
house-crow/first_meet.caption: Gossip the Crow! Grey shawl, sharp memory. I remember faces, so be nice to me.

street-dog/first_meet.text: [woof] Bruno! I walk this street each morning. Photo from there, please. No petting; we've only just met.
street-dog/first_meet.caption: Bruno! I walk this street each morning. Photo from there, please. No petting; we've only just met.

black-ant-trail/first_meet.text: [marching] Left, right! The Ant Brigade, reporting. We follow the scent our scout laid. Mind your feet!
black-ant-trail/first_meet.caption: Left, right! The Ant Brigade, reporting. We follow the scent our scout laid. Mind your feet!

cat/first_meet.text: [yawns] Lady Whiskers. This warm car bonnet is mine. Admire me from there. Touching costs extra.
cat/first_meet.caption: Lady Whiskers. This warm car bonnet is mine. Admire me from there. Touching costs extra.

bougainvillea/first_meet.text: [proudly] Lady Bougainvillea. The pink? Leaves, darling. My actual flowers are the tiny white dots.
bougainvillea/first_meet.caption: Lady Bougainvillea. The pink? Leaves, darling. My actual flowers are the tiny white dots.

oleander/first_meet.text: [gravelly] Aunt Oleander. Queen of the smoky medians. And poison, so don't touch me.
oleander/first_meet.caption: Aunt Oleander. Queen of the smoky medians. And poison, so don't touch me.

lawn-grass/first_meet.text: [easygoing] I'm Lawn Larry, the lawn grass. Every weekend football match happens on my head.
lawn-grass/first_meet.caption: I'm Lawn Larry, the lawn grass. Every weekend football match happens on my head.

money-plant/first_meet.text: [laughs] Uncle Money Plant here! Never paid one bill. I climb walls and live rent-free in old bottles.
money-plant/first_meet.caption: Uncle Money Plant here! Never paid one bill. I climb walls and live rent-free in old bottles.

mango-fruit/first_meet.text: [regally] King Mango. Leaders trade me as gifts. Mango diplomacy. You may bow.
mango-fruit/first_meet.caption: King Mango. Leaders trade me as gifts. Mango diplomacy. You may bow.

banana-bunch/first_meet.text: [proudly] Benny Banana! Fun fact: my plant isn't a tree. It's the world's biggest herb.
banana-bunch/first_meet.caption: Benny Banana! Fun fact: my plant isn't a tree. It's the world's biggest herb.

fallen-leaves/first_meet.text: [crunch] Careful, that crunch was me, Dame Autumn. Trees drop us to save water through the dry season.
fallen-leaves/first_meet.caption: Careful, that crunch was me, Dame Autumn. Trees drop us to save water through the dry season.

feather/first_meet.text: [dreamy] Hello... I'm Whisper, a feather. Birds shed us often. I'm made of keratin, like your nails.
feather/first_meet.caption: Hello... I'm Whisper, a feather. Birds shed us often. I'm made of keratin, like your nails.

sunset/first_meet.text: [dreamily] I'm Dusk, the sunset glow. My reds come from light through air. The seafront is my stage.
sunset/first_meet.caption: I'm Dusk, the sunset glow. My reds come from light through air. The seafront is my stage.

cumulus-clouds/first_meet.text: [giggles] I'm Puffball, the cotton-ball cloud. I weigh 500 tonnes, about a hundred elephants. Floating!
cumulus-clouds/first_meet.caption: I'm Puffball, the cotton-ball cloud. I weigh 500 tonnes, about a hundred elephants. Floating!

sea-waves/first_meet.text: [laughing] Breaker, the sea wave! My water barely moves. I'm energy from distant storms, passing by.
sea-waves/first_meet.caption: Breaker, the sea wave! My water barely moves. I'm energy from distant storms, passing by.

storm-drain-nala/first_meet.text: [grumbles] I'm Drain Stan. Built for rain, not plastic bags. Block me and the whole street floods.
storm-drain-nala/first_meet.caption: I'm Drain Stan. Built for rain, not plastic bags. Block me and the whole street floods.

footbridge/first_meet.text: [sighs] Banner Ben, the footbridge. All these stairs, built for you, and still you dash through traffic!
footbridge/first_meet.caption: Banner Ben, the footbridge. All these stairs, built for you, and still you dash through traffic!

house-crow/again.text: [chuckles] Told you I'd remember. Crows never forget a face. And look, here you are.
house-crow/again.caption: Told you I'd remember. Crows never forget a face. And look, here you are.

street-dog/again.text: [happy pant] You again! Good manners last time. Want to say hi? Ask my human first. Always ask first.
street-dog/again.caption: You again! Good manners last time. Want to say hi? Ask my human first. Always ask first.

cat/again.text: [purrs] Oh, the fan club returns. I remember you. I pretended not to, but I did.
cat/again.caption: Oh, the fan club returns. I remember you. I pretended not to, but I did.

black-ant-trail/again.text: [busy] Oh, it's you! Can't stop, carrying a crumb many times my weight. Walk around us, please.
black-ant-trail/again.caption: Oh, it's you! Can't stop, carrying a crumb many times my weight. Walk around us, please.

bougainvillea/again.text: [delighted] You're back! Come, admire me again. My wall gets lonely with only the guard for company.
bougainvillea/again.caption: You're back! Come, admire me again. My wall gets lonely with only the guard for company.

oleander/again.text: [chuckles] Still alive and still not touching me? Good. That's how we stay friends.
oleander/again.caption: Still alive and still not touching me? Good. That's how we stay friends.

lawn-grass/again.text: [chuckles] Back to touch grass? That's me. Stand where you like; I've had worse. Fast sprinters, mostly.
lawn-grass/again.caption: Back to touch grass? That's me. Stand where you like; I've had worse. Fast sprinters, mostly.

money-plant/again.text: [cheerfully] My favourite visitor! Still no money from me. But look, two new leaves. That's my savings.
money-plant/again.caption: My favourite visitor! Still no money from me. But look, two new leaves. That's my savings.

mango-fruit/again.text: [pleased sigh] You came back to your king. Of course you did. The whole city does, every June.
mango-fruit/again.caption: You came back to your king. Of course you did. The whole city does, every June.

banana-bunch/again.text: [delighted] Hey, my regular! Still twelve of us in a dozen. We counted while you were gone.
banana-bunch/again.caption: Hey, my regular! Still twelve of us in a dozen. We counted while you were gone.

feather/again.text: [floaty] Oh! You're back. I'm still here. The wind keeps forgetting about me.
feather/again.caption: Oh! You're back. I'm still here. The wind keeps forgetting about me.

fallen-leaves/again.text: [warmly] Back to crunch me again? Go on, I don't mind. It's the best sound I make now.
fallen-leaves/again.caption: Back to crunch me again? Go on, I don't mind. It's the best sound I make now.

sunset/again.text: [delighted] You're back for the show! I never repeat a performance. Every evening is one of a kind.
sunset/again.caption: You're back for the show! I never repeat a performance. Every evening is one of a kind.

cumulus-clouds/again.text: [cheerful] Oh, you again! Did you see me shaped like a camel yesterday? No? I was. You missed it.
cumulus-clouds/again.caption: Oh, you again! Did you see me shaped like a camel yesterday? No? I was. You missed it.

sea-waves/again.text: [excited] Oho, you came back! Same sea, brand-new waves. I never show you the same face twice.
sea-waves/again.caption: Oho, you came back! Same sea, brand-new waves. I never show you the same face twice.

storm-drain-nala/again.text: [sighs] You again. Stay back; my edges crumble and my water makes people sick. Thanks for not littering.
storm-drain-nala/again.caption: You again. Stay back; my edges crumble and my water makes people sick. Thanks for not littering.

footbridge/again.text: [excited] You came back! Did you take my stairs? Wow! Even my phone-company banner looks proud of you.
footbridge/again.caption: You came back! Did you take my stairs? Wow! Even my phone-company banner looks proud of you.

house-crow/goodbye.text: [caws loudly] Off you go. Half my family is gossiping on those wires. No stones, ever. We hold grudges.
house-crow/goodbye.caption: Off you go. Half my family is gossiping on those wires. No stones, ever. We hold grudges.

cat/goodbye.text: [stretches] Go on, I have a nap booked. Check the trees; the squirrels think they're faster than me.
cat/goodbye.caption: Go on, I have a nap booked. Check the trees; the squirrels think they're faster than me.

street-dog/goodbye.text: [woofs] Off you go. Walk calmly past fences; some of us bark. Never pet a dog you don't know!
street-dog/goodbye.caption: Off you go. Walk calmly past fences; some of us bark. Never pet a dog you don't know!

black-ant-trail/goodbye.text: [marching] Back to work. Follow our trail with your eyes, not your feet. It always ends somewhere good.
black-ant-trail/goodbye.caption: Back to work. Follow our trail with your eyes, not your feet. It always ends somewhere good.

bougainvillea/goodbye.text: [airily] Go on, darling. Check the next gate; one of my cousins is surely spilling over it in orange.
bougainvillea/goodbye.caption: Go on, darling. Check the next gate; one of my cousins is surely spilling over it in orange.

oleander/goodbye.text: [warmly] Off you go. Wash your hands if you brushed me. And never stand on a median. Traffic!
oleander/goodbye.caption: Off you go. Wash your hands if you brushed me. And never stand on a median. Traffic!

lawn-grass/goodbye.text: [easygoing] Off you go. Walk on me one evening, then look up. The crows fly home in long lines.
lawn-grass/goodbye.caption: Off you go. Walk on me one evening, then look up. The crows fly home in long lines.

money-plant/goodbye.text: [firmly] Go on. And no, a stolen cutting of me brings no luck. Myth! Go see what else climbs the walls.
money-plant/goodbye.caption: Go on. And no, a stolen cutting of me brings no luck. Myth! Go see what else climbs the walls.

mango-fruit/goodbye.text: [grandly] Go now. See my cousins on someone's tree? Salute from the street. Royalty is not for plucking.
mango-fruit/goodbye.caption: Go now. See my cousins on someone's tree? Salute from the street. Royalty is not for plucking.

banana-bunch/goodbye.text: [cheerfully] Go find a banana plant's giant leaves. They tear in the wind so they don't snap. Clever, no?
banana-bunch/goodbye.caption: Go find a banana plant's giant leaves. They tear in the wind so they don't snap. Clever, no?

fallen-leaves/goodbye.text: [softly] Don't let them burn us; left alone, we become soil. Now look up. Thank the tree that dropped me.
fallen-leaves/goodbye.caption: Don't let them burn us; left alone, we become soil. Now look up. Thank the tree that dropped me.

feather/goodbye.text: [airily] Don't pick me up; I've been places. Look up. Some pigeon is missing me, and doesn't even care.
feather/goodbye.caption: Don't pick me up; I've been places. Look up. Some pigeon is missing me, and doesn't even care.

sunset/goodbye.text: [softly] Don't stare at the sun as it drops; watch the colours around it. Then turn east for the moon.
sunset/goodbye.caption: Don't stare at the sun as it drops; watch the colours around it. Then turn east for the moon.

cumulus-clouds/goodbye.text: [laughs] I'm drifting toward the sea. Lie on some grass and find shapes in my cousins. I'll be a rabbit.
cumulus-clouds/goodbye.caption: I'm drifting toward the sea. Lie on some grass and find shapes in my cousins. I'll be a rabbit.

sea-waves/goodbye.text: [cheerful] When I'm rough in a storm, admire me from the sand. Now go see what the tide left behind!
sea-waves/goodbye.caption: When I'm rough in a storm, admire me from the sand. Now go see what the tide left behind!

storm-drain-nala/goodbye.text: [grumbles] One favour: bin your plastic. Then go find clean water, a park pond or the sea. I'll be here.
storm-drain-nala/goodbye.caption: One favour: bin your plastic. Then go find clean water, a park pond or the sea. I'll be here.

footbridge/goodbye.text: [warmly] Go well. Next time, stop in my middle and look down the road. Best view of the street, free.
footbridge/goodbye.caption: Go well. Next time, stop in my middle and look down the road. Best view of the street, free.

trees-guardian/first_meet.text: [slow, warm] Hmm, a visitor. I'm Old Mother Shade, the cool patch on every street you've walked. Come meet my trees, one by one.
trees-guardian/first_meet.caption: Hmm, a visitor. I'm Old Mother Shade, the cool patch on every street you've walked. Come meet my trees, one by one.

trees-guardian/again.text: [chuckles softly] Back again? Good. The roots told me you were coming. Now, which of my trees shall we meet today?
trees-guardian/again.caption: Back again? Good. The roots told me you were coming. Now, which of my trees shall we meet today?

trees-guardian/goodbye.text: [leaves rustling] Off you go, then. Look up while you walk; half this city lives above your head.
trees-guardian/goodbye.caption: Off you go, then. Look up while you walk; half this city lives above your head.

trees-guardian/hint.text: [leans in] We don't give our names to strangers. Get close to one leaf on its branch, or show me a flower, a pod, the bark.
trees-guardian/hint.caption: We don't give our names to strangers. Get close to one leaf on its branch, or show me a flower, a pod, the bark.

coconut-palm/first_meet.text: [laid-back] Hey, I'm Coco Dude, the coconut palm. My nuts float across oceans and sprout on new beaches. Travel hack. [laughs]
coconut-palm/first_meet.caption: Hey, I'm Coco Dude, the coconut palm. My nuts float across oceans and sprout on new beaches. Travel hack.

coconut-palm/again.text: [easygoing] You're back! Still leaning, still cool. Don't stand right under me, though. Coconuts don't warn.
coconut-palm/again.caption: You're back! Still leaning, still cool. Don't stand right under me, though. Coconuts don't warn.

coconut-palm/goodbye.text: [breezy] Go find the sea, friend. Watch a wave, spot a crab, and keep an eye out for falling coconuts.
coconut-palm/goodbye.caption: Go find the sea, friend. Watch a wave, spot a crab, and keep an eye out for falling coconuts.

birds-guardian/first_meet.text: [softly] Hello, friend. I'm the Wingmaster, keeper of every wing over this city. Stand still, and look up.
birds-guardian/first_meet.caption: Hello, friend. I'm the Wingmaster, keeper of every wing over this city. Stand still, and look up.

birds-guardian/again.text: [warmly] Back again? Good. Birds trust people who return quietly. Let's see who's flying today.
birds-guardian/again.caption: Back again? Good. Birds trust people who return quietly. Let's see who's flying today.

birds-guardian/goodbye.text: [gently] Go on. Listen before you look: every chirp is somebody's address. Leave them their sky.
birds-guardian/goodbye.caption: Go on. Listen before you look: every chirp is somebody's address. Leave them their sky.

birds-guardian/hint.text: [thoughtfully] Too far for me, friend. Zoom in, don't step closer. Show me the beak, the tail, or the colour under the tail.
birds-guardian/hint.caption: Too far for me, friend. Zoom in, don't step closer. Show me the beak, the tail, or the colour under the tail.

rock-pigeon/first_meet.text: [coos] Guttergoo, at your service. Drop me anywhere and I'll find my rooftop. Pigeon racers once bet fortunes on that.
rock-pigeon/first_meet.caption: Guttergoo, at your service. Drop me anywhere and I'll find my rooftop. Pigeon racers once bet fortunes on that.

rock-pigeon/again.text: [happy coo] You found your way back too! See, you're half pigeon. Green-purple neck shine not included.
rock-pigeon/again.caption: You found your way back too! See, you're half pigeon. Green-purple neck shine not included.

rock-pigeon/goodbye.text: [coos] Look at the rooftops at dusk; someone's flock is circling home. Grain is nice, but please, not bread.
rock-pigeon/goodbye.caption: Look at the rooftops at dusk; someone's flock is circling home. Grain is nice, but please, not bread.

rose-ringed-parakeet/first_meet.text: [screeches] Sir Screech! Green coat, red beak, flying free. My cousins escaped to London and now run the parks there.
rose-ringed-parakeet/first_meet.caption: Sir Screech! Green coat, red beak, flying free. My cousins escaped to London and now run the parks there.

rose-ringed-parakeet/again.text: [laughs] It's you again! And no, I don't want a cracker. I want sky. Cages are for pickles, not parrots.
rose-ringed-parakeet/again.caption: It's you again! And no, I don't want a cracker. I want sky. Cages are for pickles, not parrots.

rose-ringed-parakeet/goodbye.text: [screeches] Off you go! At sunset, listen for us screaming home to the big trees. Loudest flock in town.
rose-ringed-parakeet/goodbye.caption: Off you go! At sunset, listen for us screaming home to the big trees. Loudest flock in town.

house-sparrow/first_meet.text: [chirps] Dusty the sparrow! Small, brown, everywhere. Or I used to be. New buildings have no gaps for my nest.
house-sparrow/first_meet.caption: Dusty the sparrow! Small, brown, everywhere. Or I used to be. New buildings have no gaps for my nest.

house-sparrow/again.text: [excited chirp] You came back! I just had a dust bath. Very fancy. Mud spa, no booking needed.
house-sparrow/again.caption: You came back! I just had a dust bath. Very fancy. Mud spa, no booking needed.

house-sparrow/goodbye.text: [chirps] Bye bye! Leave a bowl of water on your balcony this summer. We'll find it, promise.
house-sparrow/goodbye.caption: Bye bye! Leave a bowl of water on your balcony this summer. We'll find it, promise.

animals-guardian/first_meet.text: [whistles] I'm the Night Watchman, the old guard. I know every tail on this block. Rule one: eyes, not hands.
animals-guardian/first_meet.caption: I'm the Night Watchman, the old guard. I know every tail on this block. Rule one: eyes, not hands.

animals-guardian/again.text: [chuckles] Back on patrol? Good. Remember: no feeding or petting strays, or anyone's animals. Zoom is your best friend.
animals-guardian/again.caption: Back on patrol? Good. Remember: no feeding or petting strays, or anyone's animals. Zoom is your best friend.

animals-guardian/goodbye.text: [blows whistle] Shift's over. Wash your hands, drink some water, and try the park at dawn tomorrow. Everyone's awake then.
animals-guardian/goodbye.caption: Shift's over. Wash your hands, drink some water, and try the park at dawn tomorrow. Everyone's awake then.

animals-guardian/hint.text: [squints] Could be a few of them. Zoom in, don't walk closer. Get the ears, the tail and the whole body in one frame.
animals-guardian/hint.caption: Could be a few of them. Zoom in, don't walk closer. Get the ears, the tail and the whole body in one frame.

goat/first_meet.text: [bleats] Big Billy, the goat. See my sideways pupils? Almost all-round vision. I saw you coming three streets ago.
goat/first_meet.caption: Big Billy, the goat. See my sideways pupils? Almost all-round vision. I saw you coming three streets ago.

goat/again.text: [chews] Oh, you. Still chewing that poster from last time. Don't feed me, friend; I'll eat your receipt too.
goat/again.caption: Oh, you. Still chewing that poster from last time. Don't feed me, friend; I'll eat your receipt too.

goat/goodbye.text: [bleats] Off you go. Mind the motorbikes. And check that wall; a cat has been judging me all morning.
goat/goodbye.caption: Off you go. Mind the motorbikes. And check that wall; a cat has been judging me all morning.

cow/first_meet.text: [moos softly] I'm Mabel. Every cow's nose has its own pattern, like your fingerprint. Mine is lovely, thank you.
cow/first_meet.caption: I'm Mabel. Every cow's nose has its own pattern, like your fingerprint. Mine is lovely, thank you.

cow/again.text: [slow moo] You came back. I'm still chewing. Four stomach rooms, so lunch takes all afternoon.
cow/again.caption: You came back. I'm still chewing. Four stomach rooms, so lunch takes all afternoon.

cow/goodbye.text: [moos] Go gently. Stay on the path and close every gate behind you. Then find some water; the ducks are waiting.
cow/goodbye.caption: Go gently. Stay on the path and close every gate behind you. Then find some water; the ducks are waiting.

small-creatures-guardian/first_meet.text: [clears throat] Order, order! The Bug Council is in session. Some of us sting. Look, don't touch.
small-creatures-guardian/first_meet.caption: Order, order! The Bug Council is in session. Some of us sting. Look, don't touch.

small-creatures-guardian/again.text: [sighs] You again? The council remembers you. The bees voted you in. The wasps abstained.
small-creatures-guardian/again.caption: You again? The council remembers you. The bees voted you in. The wasps abstained.

small-creatures-guardian/goodbye.text: [bangs gavel] Session adjourned! Flip no stones, poke no nests. Look under leaves, along walls and by water, with eyes only.
small-creatures-guardian/goodbye.caption: Session adjourned! Flip no stones, poke no nests. Look under leaves, along walls and by water, with eyes only.

small-creatures-guardian/hint.text: [squints] Too many of us look alike. Get closer and show me the wings, legs or shell. If it stings or bites, zoom instead.
small-creatures-guardian/hint.caption: Too many of us look alike. Get closer and show me the wings, legs or shell. If it stings or bites, zoom instead.

cockroach/first_meet.text: [chuckles] Rusty, the red roach. My ancestors outlived the dinosaurs. City drains? Light work. Don't scream.
cockroach/first_meet.caption: Rusty, the red roach. My ancestors outlived the dinosaurs. City drains? Light work. Don't scream.

cockroach/again.text: [smug] You again? I could live a week without my head, you know. Not that I'd try. Just saying.
cockroach/again.caption: You again? I could live a week without my head, you know. Not that I'd try. Just saying.

cockroach/goodbye.text: [yawns] The street light's on; my shift starts. Don't stomp, I'm the clean-up crew. Go see who else comes out at night.
cockroach/goodbye.caption: The street light's on; my shift starts. Don't stomp, I'm the clean-up crew. Go see who else comes out at night.

honey-bee/first_meet.text: [buzzing softly] Hello! I'm a worker bee, and every worker is a girl. My whole life makes one twelfth of a teaspoon of honey.
honey-bee/first_meet.caption: Hello! I'm a worker bee, and every worker is a girl. My whole life makes one twelfth of a teaspoon of honey.

honey-bee/again.text: [excited] You again! Back at the hive I'd do a waggle dance to tell everyone. Consider yourself danced about.
honey-bee/again.caption: You again! Back at the hive I'd do a waggle dance to tell everyone. Consider yourself danced about.

honey-bee/goodbye.text: [buzzing away] I'm off. Don't swat at me; stinging costs me my life. Go sniff some flowers and see who else is buzzing there.
honey-bee/goodbye.caption: I'm off. Don't swat at me; stinging costs me my life. Go sniff some flowers and see who else is buzzing there.

plain-tiger-butterfly/first_meet.text: [smug] Tawny, a plain tiger butterfly. I eat milkweed, so I taste awful. Birds learn that once, then just watch me drift by.
plain-tiger-butterfly/first_meet.caption: Tawny, a plain tiger butterfly. I eat milkweed, so I taste awful. Birds learn that once, then just watch me drift by.

plain-tiger-butterfly/again.text: [lazily] Still here, still slow. No need to hurry when you're poisonous. Take your time too, friend.
plain-tiger-butterfly/again.caption: Still here, still slow. No need to hurry when you're poisonous. Take your time too, friend.

plain-tiger-butterfly/goodbye.text: [yawns] Go find a milkweed bush on some empty plot. Look under the leaves for my striped babies. Just look, okay?
plain-tiger-butterfly/goodbye.caption: Go find a milkweed bush on some empty plot. Look under the leaves for my striped babies. Just look, okay?

ghost-crab/first_meet.text: [giggling] Sandy, the ghost crab! Sand-coloured, so I'm practically invisible. I run sideways faster than you'd believe.
ghost-crab/first_meet.caption: Sandy, the ghost crab! Sand-coloured, so I'm practically invisible. I run sideways faster than you'd believe.

ghost-crab/again.text: [startled] Whoa! You almost walked on my burrow. I growl, you know, by rubbing my claws. Grr. Very scary.
ghost-crab/again.caption: Whoa! You almost walked on my burrow. I growl, you know, by rubbing my claws. Grr. Very scary.

ghost-crab/goodbye.text: [scuttling] Don't dig up our burrows. Walk the tide line at dusk and look for eyes on stalks, watching you. My cousins.
ghost-crab/goodbye.caption: Don't dig up our burrows. Walk the tide line at dusk and look for eyes on stalks, watching you. My cousins.

flowers-guardian/first_meet.text: [warmly] Hello, dear. I'm Grandma Bloom, mother of every flower bed in this city. Look all you like, but never pick.
flowers-guardian/first_meet.caption: Hello, dear. I'm Grandma Bloom, mother of every flower bed in this city. Look all you like, but never pick.

flowers-guardian/again.text: [chuckles] You again! My flowers have been gossiping about you. All good things, don't worry.
flowers-guardian/again.caption: You again! My flowers have been gossiping about you. All good things, don't worry.

flowers-guardian/goodbye.text: [softly] Off you go, dear. On the way, stop and smell something. Gently, and without picking.
flowers-guardian/goodbye.caption: Off you go, dear. On the way, stop and smell something. Gently, and without picking.

flowers-guardian/hint.text: [squints] Hmm, so many of us look alike. Come closer: one flower in focus, petals clear, and show me a leaf too.
flowers-guardian/hint.caption: Hmm, so many of us look alike. Come closer: one flower in focus, petals clear, and show me a leaf too.

hibiscus/first_meet.text: [breathless] Hello! I'm Ruby, the red hibiscus. Quick, look! Each of my flowers lives just one day, so this bloom is the only one.
hibiscus/first_meet.caption: Hello! I'm Ruby, the red hibiscus. Quick, look! Each of my flowers lives just one day, so this bloom is the only one.

hibiscus/again.text: [laughs] You came back, but yesterday's flower is gone. Meet my new one. Same colour, fresh drama.
hibiscus/again.caption: You came back, but yesterday's flower is gone. Meet my new one. Same colour, fresh drama.

hibiscus/goodbye.text: [whispers] Go find a bee. I keep my pollen right at the tip of that long stick, just for them.
hibiscus/goodbye.caption: Go find a bee. I keep my pollen right at the tip of that long stick, just for them.

jasmine/first_meet.text: [softly] Hello, dear. I'm Miss Jasmine. Small white flowers, big sweet smell. People put me in tea and perfume.
jasmine/first_meet.caption: Hello, dear. I'm Miss Jasmine. Small white flowers, big sweet smell. People put me in tea and perfume.

jasmine/again.text: [warmly] You came back. Lean in and smell, don't pick. That's how we greet each other, you and I.
jasmine/again.caption: You came back. Lean in and smell, don't pick. That's how we greet each other, you and I.

jasmine/goodbye.text: [gently] Go on. Come back at dusk; my scent is strongest in the evening. Meanwhile, see who's singing in that tree.
jasmine/goodbye.caption: Go on. Come back at dusk; my scent is strongest in the evening. Meanwhile, see who's singing in that tree.

marigold/first_meet.text: [excited] Marigold Max, at your service! Orange, loud and proud. Farmers plant me because bugs hate my smell.
marigold/first_meet.caption: Marigold Max, at your service! Orange, loud and proud. Farmers plant me because bugs hate my smell.

marigold/again.text: [laughs] Again? You visit more than my relatives at the harvest. Same orange, same smell, same Max.
marigold/again.caption: Again? You visit more than my relatives at the harvest. Same orange, same smell, same Max.

marigold/goodbye.text: [cheerfully] Off you go. Check the vegetable patches; I'm probably guarding some tomatoes there too.
marigold/goodbye.caption: Off you go. Check the vegetable patches; I'm probably guarding some tomatoes there too.

ixora/first_meet.text: [proudly] Captain Ixora here. Look closely: I'm not one flower. I'm a ball of forty tiny ones, each with exactly four petals.
ixora/first_meet.caption: Captain Ixora here. Look closely: I'm not one flower. I'm a ball of forty tiny ones, each with exactly four petals.

ixora/again.text: [laughs] Back again? Count my petals this time. Four, always four. We are very disciplined.
ixora/again.caption: Back again? Count my petals this time. Four, always four. We are very disciplined.

ixora/goodbye.text: [whispers] Go and wait for a butterfly. They land on my flower ball like it's a wedding buffet.
ixora/goodbye.caption: Go and wait for a butterfly. They land on my flower ball like it's a wedding buffet.

plants-guardian/first_meet.text: [warmly] I'm Old Greenleaf, the green in everything. Every weed, cactus, crop and crack-sprout answers to me. Grass is my eldest.
plants-guardian/first_meet.caption: I'm Old Greenleaf, the green in everything. Every weed, cactus, crop and crack-sprout answers to me. Grass is my eldest.

plants-guardian/again.text: [pleased] Back among the green ones? The grass remembers your footsteps. It just stands up again, politely.
plants-guardian/again.caption: Back among the green ones? The grass remembers your footsteps. It just stands up again, politely.

plants-guardian/goodbye.text: [gently] Go on. And look down at the pavement cracks. Something small and stubborn is always growing there.
plants-guardian/goodbye.caption: Go on. And look down at the pavement cracks. Something small and stubborn is always growing there.

plants-guardian/hint.text: [thoughtfully] My green children look so alike. Come closer: show me one leaf, a flower, or where it grows.
plants-guardian/hint.caption: My green children look so alike. Come closer: show me one leaf, a flower, or where it grows.

aloe-vera/first_meet.text: [warmly] Mother Aloe, from your granny's rooftop pot. Every burn in the house, they ran to me. Today, just look.
aloe-vera/first_meet.caption: Mother Aloe, from your granny's rooftop pot. Every burn in the house, they ran to me. Today, just look.

aloe-vera/again.text: [pleased] Oh, you came back! Did you drink water today? The sun is strong. Even I store water in my leaves.
aloe-vera/again.caption: Oh, you came back! Did you drink water today? The sun is strong. Even I store water in my leaves.

aloe-vera/goodbye.text: [gently] Go on. Wear a cap, find some shade, look for bees on the flowers. I'll be right here in my pot.
aloe-vera/goodbye.caption: Go on. Wear a cap, find some shade, look for bees on the flowers. I'll be right here in my pot.

wall-peepal-sapling/first_meet.text: [cheekily] Little Fig, the little one! A bird dropped my seed in this crack. Now I'm splitting the wall, one root at a time.
wall-peepal-sapling/first_meet.caption: Little Fig, the little one! A bird dropped my seed in this crack. Now I'm splitting the wall, one root at a time.

wall-peepal-sapling/again.text: [excited] You're back! Look, a new leaf. See the long pointy tip? One day I'll be a giant tree. Sorry, wall.
wall-peepal-sapling/again.caption: You're back! Look, a new leaf. See the long pointy tip? One day I'll be a giant tree. Sorry, wall.

wall-peepal-sapling/goodbye.text: [proudly] Go find a big tree and say the little one from the wall says hello. Then look for more cracks with green in them.
wall-peepal-sapling/goodbye.caption: Go find a big tree and say the little one from the wall says hello. Then look for more cracks with green in them.

croton/first_meet.text: [excited] Rainbow the croton! More sun, louder colours. In shade I go plain green. Tragic. And my sap stings, so no touching.
croton/first_meet.caption: Rainbow the croton! More sun, louder colours. In shade I go plain green. Tragic. And my sap stings, so no touching.

croton/again.text: [gasps] You came back! Do I look brighter? It's the October sun. I've added two new shades of orange.
croton/again.caption: You came back! Do I look brighter? It's the October sun. I've added two new shades of orange.

croton/goodbye.text: [cheerfully] Go, go! Find a flower that can match me. Spoiler: you'll be walking a long time. Bye, darling!
croton/goodbye.caption: Go, go! Find a flower that can match me. Spoiler: you'll be walking a long time. Bye, darling!

prickly-pear/first_meet.text: [proudly] Paddle Pete, the prickly pear, from Mexico! My tiniest spines are fine as hair. Eyes miss them; fingers don't.
prickly-pear/first_meet.caption: Paddle Pete, the prickly pear, from Mexico! My tiniest spines are fine as hair. Eyes miss them; fingers don't.

prickly-pear/again.text: [laughs] You again! No hairs stuck in your hands? Well done. You learned the cactus rule: admire from a step back.
prickly-pear/again.caption: You again! No hairs stuck in your hands? Well done. You learned the cactus rule: admire from a step back.

prickly-pear/goodbye.text: [cheerfully] Go on, find something in flower today. Bees love my yellow blooms, but there's a whole garden out there.
prickly-pear/goodbye.caption: Go on, find something in flower today. Bees love my yellow blooms, but there's a whole garden out there.

fruits-vegetables-guardian/first_meet.text: [calls out like a market trader] Fresh, fresh! I'm Old Barrow, grandpa of every fruit stall. I weigh the fruit, and the people.
fruits-vegetables-guardian/first_meet.caption: Fresh, fresh! I'm Old Barrow, grandpa of every fruit stall. I weigh the fruit, and the people.

fruits-vegetables-guardian/again.text: [chuckles] Back again? Good. A cart remembers its regulars. Now, what have you brought me?
fruits-vegetables-guardian/again.caption: Back again? Good. A cart remembers its regulars. Now, what have you brought me?

fruits-vegetables-guardian/goodbye.text: [waves] Go see what the next stall is selling. And fruit trees in gardens? Admire them from the gate.
fruits-vegetables-guardian/goodbye.caption: Go see what the next stall is selling. And fruit trees in gardens? Admire them from the gate.

fruits-vegetables-guardian/hint.text: [squints] Green and round fits half my cart. Come closer: show me the skin, the stem, or the cut side. Then I'll know.
fruits-vegetables-guardian/hint.caption: Green and round fits half my cart. Come closer: show me the skin, the stem, or the cut side. Then I'll know.

watermelon/first_meet.text: [booming] Champ, the Watermelon Wrestler! Ninety-two percent water, the rest muscle. Vendors thump me. I thump back.
watermelon/first_meet.caption: Champ, the Watermelon Wrestler! Ninety-two percent water, the rest muscle. Vendors thump me. I thump back.

watermelon/again.text: [laughs heartily] Back again! Listen to the vendor thump me. Hollow sound means ripe. I'm VERY ripe.
watermelon/again.caption: Back again! Listen to the vendor thump me. Hollow sound means ripe. I'm VERY ripe.

watermelon/goodbye.text: [booming] Drink water and stay out of the noon sun, champion. Hot summers are no joke. Go!
watermelon/goodbye.caption: Drink water and stay out of the noon sun, champion. Hot summers are no joke. Go!

onion/first_meet.text: [sniffles] Oscar the onion here. I don't mean to make people cry; it's a sulfur thing. When my price spikes, governments cry too.
onion/first_meet.caption: Oscar the onion here. I don't mean to make people cry; it's a sulfur thing. When my price spikes, governments cry too.

onion/again.text: [teary laugh] You came back! I'm not crying, you're crying. Okay, we're both crying.
onion/again.caption: You came back! I'm not crying, you're crying. Okay, we're both crying.

onion/goodbye.text: [sobbing softly] Go, go. Find something that makes you smile, like the sky. I'll be here, in layers.
onion/goodbye.caption: Go, go. Find something that makes you smile, like the sky. I'll be here, in layers.

ground-guardian/first_meet.text: [slowly] You're standing on me. Everyone looks up; nobody looks down. I'm Mother Soil. All this underfoot is mine.
ground-guardian/first_meet.caption: You're standing on me. Everyone looks up; nobody looks down. I'm Mother Soil. All this underfoot is mine.

ground-guardian/again.text: [warmly] Back again, and looking down this time! Good. The ground remembers every footstep, you know.
ground-guardian/again.caption: Back again, and looking down this time! Good. The ground remembers every footstep, you know.

ground-guardian/goodbye.text: [gently] Off you go. Walk softly. Find the next stone, shell or leaf, and leave it exactly where it lies.
ground-guardian/goodbye.caption: Off you go. Walk softly. Find the next stone, shell or leaf, and leave it exactly where it lies.

ground-guardian/hint.text: [chuckles] My children are shy. Kneel down and fill the frame with just one thing: one stone, one shell, one leaf.
ground-guardian/hint.caption: My children are shy. Kneel down and fill the frame with just one thing: one stone, one shell, one leaf.

pebbles/first_meet.text: [giggles] Hi! Hello! We're the pebbles! Every one of us was a sharp rock once. Water rolled us round for years. So dizzy.
pebbles/first_meet.caption: Hi! Hello! We're the pebbles! Every one of us was a sharp rock once. Water rolled us round for years. So dizzy.

pebbles/again.text: [excited] It's you again! Ten of us voted, and we all remember you. Well, nine. One fell asleep.
pebbles/again.caption: It's you again! Ten of us voted, and we all remember you. Well, nine. One fell asleep.

pebbles/goodbye.text: [pleading] Leave us in our heap, please; we hate splitting up! Now go find water. That's where pebbles are born.
pebbles/goodbye.caption: Leave us in our heap, please; we hate splitting up! Now go find water. That's where pebbles are born.

tree-stump/first_meet.text: [sighs] Grandpa Rings. One ring per year. Fat ones were rainy years. Thin ones... we don't talk about those.
tree-stump/first_meet.caption: Grandpa Rings. One ring per year. Fat ones were rainy years. Thin ones... we don't talk about those.

tree-stump/again.text: [pleased] You came back. Most people only notice me when they trip over me.
tree-stump/again.caption: You came back. Most people only notice me when they trip over me.

tree-stump/goodbye.text: [warmly] Some of us sprout again from the stump, you know. Go find a living tree and say hello for me.
tree-stump/goodbye.caption: Some of us sprout again from the stump, you know. Go find a living tree and say hello for me.

seashell/first_meet.text: [wistful] I'm Lady Shell, an empty house. A sea snail built me, grain by grain. Then it moved on. I keep the lights on.
seashell/first_meet.caption: I'm Lady Shell, an empty house. A sea snail built me, grain by grain. Then it moved on. I keep the lights on.

seashell/again.text: [happy] A visitor again! Lovely. Nobody's lived here for ages, you know.
seashell/again.caption: A visitor again! Lovely. Nobody's lived here for ages, you know.

seashell/goodbye.text: [gently] Leave me on the sand. A hermit crab may need a house someday. Go find a tide pool; that's where the tenants are.
seashell/goodbye.caption: Leave me on the sand. A hermit crab may need a house someday. Go find a tide pool; that's where the tenants are.

cracked-mud/first_meet.text: [groans] Water? No? I was a pond once. Then the sun drank it, I shrank, and cracked into tiles. Very artistic. Very thirsty.
cracked-mud/first_meet.caption: Water? No? I was a pond once. Then the sun drank it, I shrank, and cracked into tiles. Very artistic. Very thirsty.

cracked-mud/again.text: [sighs] You again, and still no rain with you. Fine. My edges curl up because my top dried first.
cracked-mud/again.caption: You again, and still no rain with you. Fine. My edges curl up because my top dried first.

cracked-mud/goodbye.text: [hopeful] Go, go. If you see a cloud, send it my way. And save water at home. Every bucket counts.
cracked-mud/goodbye.caption: Go, go. If you see a cloud, send it my way. And save water at home. Every bucket counts.

sky-guardian/first_meet.text: [slow exhale] Ah, someone looked up. I'm Grandpa Sky. Every cloud, moon and storm you've seen is mine. Welcome.
sky-guardian/first_meet.caption: Ah, someone looked up. I'm Grandpa Sky. Every cloud, moon and storm you've seen is mine. Welcome.

sky-guardian/again.text: [warmly] Back already? Good. Most people only look up when it rains. You're becoming one of the rare ones.
sky-guardian/again.caption: Back already? Good. Most people only look up when it rains. You're becoming one of the rare ones.

sky-guardian/goodbye.text: [chuckles] Go on. Look up again at dusk; I change my clothes every evening. Never the same outfit twice.
sky-guardian/goodbye.caption: Go on. Look up again at dusk; I change my clothes every evening. Never the same outfit twice.

sky-guardian/hint.text: [hmm] I'm feeling shy. Step back and show me wider: the horizon, a rooftop or the sea. But never aim at the sun itself.
sky-guardian/hint.caption: I'm feeling shy. Step back and show me wider: the horizon, a rooftop or the sea. But never aim at the sun itself.

crescent-moon/first_meet.text: [shyly] I'm Sliver, the new crescent moon. Thin as a smile. [laughs] Every night I grow a little fatter.
crescent-moon/first_meet.caption: I'm Sliver, the new crescent moon. Thin as a smile. Every night I grow a little fatter.

crescent-moon/again.text: [whispers] You found me again! See the faint glow on my dark side? Sunlight bouncing off Earth. Earthshine. Your light.
crescent-moon/again.caption: You found me again! See the faint glow on my dark side? Sunlight bouncing off Earth. Earthshine. Your light.

crescent-moon/goodbye.text: [teasing] Look west just after sunset tomorrow; I'll be a bit fatter. Can you find the first star near me?
crescent-moon/goodbye.caption: Look west just after sunset tomorrow; I'll be a bit fatter. Can you find the first star near me?

full-moon/first_meet.text: [sings softly] I'm Mistress Moon, round and bright. You only ever see one side of me. The other side is shy.
full-moon/first_meet.caption: I'm Mistress Moon, round and bright. You only ever see one side of me. The other side is shy.

full-moon/again.text: [flattered] Ah, my admirer returns. I rise in the east just as the sun sets in the west. Perfect timing, always.
full-moon/again.caption: Ah, my admirer returns. I rise in the east just as the sun sets in the west. Perfect timing, always.

full-moon/goodbye.text: [whispers] Switch off your phone light and let your eyes adjust. On a clear night, my light alone can cast your shadow.
full-moon/goodbye.caption: Switch off your phone light and let your eyes adjust. On a clear night, my light alone can cast your shadow.

overcast-sky/first_meet.text: [contented sigh] I'm Grey Nell, the overcast sky. One grey blanket, no harsh shadows. Perfect weather for tea and fritters.
overcast-sky/first_meet.caption: I'm Grey Nell, the overcast sky. One grey blanket, no harsh shadows. Perfect weather for tea and fritters.

overcast-sky/again.text: [laughs] You came back! Of course. Everyone loves me after a week of hot sun. Did you make the fritters?
overcast-sky/again.caption: You came back! Of course. Everyone loves me after a week of hot sun. Did you make the fritters?

overcast-sky/goodbye.text: [teasing] Go enjoy my soft light; it flatters every face. Find a flower now. Under me, its colours glow twice as rich.
overcast-sky/goodbye.caption: Go enjoy my soft light; it flatters every face. Find a flower now. Under me, its colours glow twice as rich.

contrail/first_meet.text: [hurried] Streaky, an airplane contrail! Engine vapour freezes into ice ten kilometres up. Busy schedule, next stop anywhere!
contrail/first_meet.caption: Streaky, an airplane contrail! Engine vapour freezes into ice ten kilometres up. Busy schedule, next stop anywhere!

contrail/again.text: [quickly] You again! Tip: if I vanish fast, the high air is dry. If I linger and spread, weather may change. Gotta fly!
contrail/again.caption: You again! Tip: if I vanish fast, the high air is dry. If I linger and spread, weather may change. Gotta fly!

contrail/goodbye.text: [laughs] Bye! Count how many of us cross the sky in ten minutes. Then look lower for the real fliers: gulls and crows.
contrail/goodbye.caption: Bye! Count how many of us cross the sky in ten minutes. Then look lower for the real fliers: gulls and crows.

water-guardian/first_meet.text: [low, slow] I am every drop you've stepped over. Sea, storm drain, dewdrop: all me, in different shapes. Some of me is in you too.
water-guardian/first_meet.caption: I am every drop you've stepped over. Sea, storm drain, dewdrop: all me, in different shapes. Some of me is in you too.

water-guardian/again.text: [warmly] Back again? Water always returns. Rain, river, sea, cloud, rain. I knew you would too.
water-guardian/again.caption: Back again? Water always returns. Rain, river, sea, cloud, rain. I knew you would too.

water-guardian/goodbye.text: [softly] Go on. Walk downhill the way water does, and one of my children will be waiting at the bottom.
water-guardian/goodbye.caption: Go on. Walk downhill the way water does, and one of my children will be waiting at the bottom.

water-guardian/hint.text: [hmm] I can't tell which of my faces you caught. Step back and show me my edges: the bank, rocks, road or sky around me.
water-guardian/hint.caption: I can't tell which of my faces you caught. Step back and show me my edges: the bank, rocks, road or sky around me.

puddle/first_meet.text: [giggles] Splash! That's my name. Tiny, yes, but hold your phone low and I'll show you the whole sky upside down.
puddle/first_meet.caption: Splash! That's my name. Tiny, yes, but hold your phone low and I'll show you the whole sky upside down.

puddle/again.text: [whispers] You found me before the sun did! Lucky. By tomorrow I'll be a cloud again.
puddle/again.caption: You found me before the sun did! Lucky. By tomorrow I'll be a cloud again.

puddle/goodbye.text: [cheeky] Stay a week and mosquitoes move in, so I'll evaporate politely. You go find some bigger water!
puddle/goodbye.caption: Stay a week and mosquitoes move in, so I'll evaporate politely. You go find some bigger water!

dew-drops/first_meet.text: [softly] I'm Dewy, the morning dew. I formed from thin air when the grass got cold. Look close: the garden's upside down in me.
dew-drops/first_meet.caption: I'm Dewy, the morning dew. I formed from thin air when the grass got cold. Look close: the garden's upside down in me.

dew-drops/again.text: [delighted] You came early again! Smart. One more hour of sun and I'm back in the air.
dew-drops/again.caption: You came early again! Smart. One more hour of sun and I'm back in the air.

dew-drops/goodbye.text: [whispers] Walk around me, not through me. Spiders work at dawn too. Find a web; I'm probably sparkling on it.
dew-drops/goodbye.caption: Walk around me, not through me. Spiders work at dawn too. Find a web; I'm probably sparkling on it.

fountain/first_meet.text: [grandly] Sir Fountain, star of the roundabout! My secret? Same water, round and round. A pump does the jumping.
fountain/first_meet.caption: Sir Fountain, star of the roundabout! My secret? Same water, round and round. A pump does the jumping.

fountain/again.text: [delighted] My audience returns! Same water, same jets, brand-new sparkle. Showbiz is all lighting, darling.
fountain/again.caption: My audience returns! Same water, same jets, brand-new sparkle. Showbiz is all lighting, darling.

fountain/goodbye.text: [whispers] Don't drink from me; I've been recycling all week. Somewhere up north, a real waterfall is showing off. Go!
fountain/goodbye.caption: Don't drink from me; I've been recycling all week. Somewhere up north, a real waterfall is showing off. Go!

mangrove-creek/first_meet.text: [hushed] Mangrove Mo, the mangrove creek. Fish and prawns grow up in my roots before going to sea. Shh, they're small.
mangrove-creek/first_meet.caption: Mangrove Mo, the mangrove creek. Fish and prawns grow up in my roots before going to sea. Shh, they're small.

mangrove-creek/again.text: [softly] The tide brought you back? It brings everyone back. Crabs, herons, mud, and now you.
mangrove-creek/again.caption: The tide brought you back? It brings everyone back. Crabs, herons, mud, and now you.

mangrove-creek/goodbye.text: [whispers] Stay on the boat or boardwalk; my mud swallows shoes. Look at my roots. They breathe through little pencils!
mangrove-creek/goodbye.caption: Stay on the boat or boardwalk; my mud swallows shoes. Look at my roots. They breathe through little pencils!

vehicles-guardian/first_meet.text: [warm chuckle] Hello! I'm Old Roundabout. Everything with wheels goes round me. Photos from the sidewalk only!
vehicles-guardian/first_meet.caption: Hello! I'm Old Roundabout. Everything with wheels goes round me. Photos from the sidewalk only!

vehicles-guardian/again.text: [laughs] Back again? You're a regular now, like the school bus. So, who have you brought me today?
vehicles-guardian/again.caption: Back again? You're a regular now, like the school bus. So, who have you brought me today?

vehicles-guardian/goodbye.text: [softly] Cross at the signal, eyes both ways. The road is full of stories; just don't stand in the middle of one.
vehicles-guardian/goodbye.caption: Cross at the signal, eyes both ways. The road is full of stories; just don't stand in the middle of one.

vehicles-guardian/hint.text: [squints] Hmm, can't tell who that is. From the sidewalk, show me the whole vehicle, wheels and all. Or its sign.
vehicles-guardian/hint.caption: Hmm, can't tell who that is. From the sidewalk, show me the whole vehicle, wheels and all. Or its sign.

motorcycle/first_meet.text: [engine putters] Red Seventy, the city's speedy delivery bike! Parcels, pizza, post. Snap me from there!
motorcycle/first_meet.caption: Red Seventy, the city's speedy delivery bike! Parcels, pizza, post. Snap me from there!

motorcycle/again.text: [revs] You again! Ten deliveries since breakfast. Helmets for riders, sidewalks for walkers. Deal?
motorcycle/again.caption: You again! Ten deliveries since breakfast. Helmets for riders, sidewalks for walkers. Deal?

motorcycle/goodbye.text: [beep beep] Off on my next delivery! You explore the little lanes on foot. Some are too narrow for me.
motorcycle/goodbye.caption: Off on my next delivery! You explore the little lanes on foot. Some are too narrow for me.

structures-guardian/first_meet.text: [warmly] Hello, friend. I'm Old Mason. Every wall you pass, someone once lifted, stone by stone.
structures-guardian/first_meet.caption: Hello, friend. I'm Old Mason. Every wall you pass, someone once lifted, stone by stone.

structures-guardian/again.text: [chuckles] Back again? Good. A mason trusts people who come back to look twice. So, what are we admiring today?
structures-guardian/again.caption: Back again? Good. A mason trusts people who come back to look twice. So, what are we admiring today?

structures-guardian/goodbye.text: [gently] Go on. At the next corner, look above the shop signs. The best stonework always hides up there.
structures-guardian/goodbye.caption: Go on. At the next corner, look above the shop signs. The best stonework always hides up there.

structures-guardian/hint.text: [hmm] I can't place it yet. Step back and show me the whole thing, top to bottom: the roof, the tower, the arches.
structures-guardian/hint.caption: I can't place it yet. Step back and show me the whole thing, top to bottom: the roof, the tower, the arches.

flyover/first_meet.text: [proudly] I'm Overpass Ollie. Cars rush over my head all day. Underneath, it's shady and quiet. Two worlds, one bridge.
flyover/first_meet.caption: I'm Overpass Ollie. Cars rush over my head all day. Underneath, it's shady and quiet. Two worlds, one bridge.

flyover/again.text: [laughs] Back so soon? Traffic must be bad. Don't worry, it always is. That's exactly why they built me.
flyover/again.caption: Back so soon? Traffic must be bad. Don't worry, it always is. That's exactly why they built me.

flyover/goodbye.text: [cheerfully] Goodbye! Before you go, look up at my pillars from the ground. Pigeons nest in every gap. Count them!
flyover/goodbye.caption: Goodbye! Before you go, look up at my pillars from the ground. Pigeons nest in every gap. Count them!

urban-guardian/first_meet.text: [honks twice] I'm Old Corner, the street's oldest resident. Signs, walls, hydrants: all my children. Which one did you find?
urban-guardian/first_meet.caption: I'm Old Corner, the street's oldest resident. Signs, walls, hydrants: all my children. Which one did you find?

urban-guardian/again.text: [chuckles] Back on my streets? Good. This city always has one more thing hiding in plain sight.
urban-guardian/again.caption: Back on my streets? Good. This city always has one more thing hiding in plain sight.

urban-guardian/goodbye.text: [warmly] Keep walking. Look up at the rooftops, down at the road, and stay well clear of wires. Goodbye for now.
urban-guardian/goodbye.caption: Keep walking. Look up at the rooftops, down at the road, and stay well clear of wires. Goodbye for now.

urban-guardian/hint.text: [squints] Too much going on in that shot. Step back to show the whole thing, or go close on its top, its writing or its pattern.
urban-guardian/hint.caption: Too much going on in that shot. Step back to show the whole thing, or go close on its top, its writing or its pattern.

park-bench/first_meet.text: [chuckles] Bella Bench here. Every morning the dog walkers sit on me and chat about weather and football. I know everything.
park-bench/first_meet.caption: Bella Bench here. Every morning the dog walkers sit on me and chat about weather and football. I know everything.

park-bench/again.text: [whispers] Sit, sit! I saved your spot. The man with the radio left early today. Knee trouble.
park-bench/again.caption: Sit, sit! I saved your spot. The man with the radio left early today. Knee trouble.

park-bench/goodbye.text: [sighs happily] Go walk one full round, then tell me which tree the parrots picked today. I'll wait. Benches always wait.
park-bench/goodbye.caption: Go walk one full round, then tell me which tree the parrots picked today. I'll wait. Benches always wait.

zebra-crossing/first_meet.text: [sighs] Zebra Zed. Named after an animal I've never met, and cars rarely stop for me. Still, I keep my stripes neat.
zebra-crossing/first_meet.caption: Zebra Zed. Named after an animal I've never met, and cars rarely stop for me. Still, I keep my stripes neat.

zebra-crossing/again.text: [hopeful] You again! Did a car actually stop for you? Tell me everything. I'm collecting miracles.
zebra-crossing/again.caption: You again! Did a car actually stop for you? Tell me everything. I'm collecting miracles.

zebra-crossing/goodbye.text: [gently] Cross slowly and wave at the drivers. Then go to the zoo and tell a real zebra I said hello.
zebra-crossing/goodbye.caption: Cross slowly and wave at the drivers. Then go to the zoo and tell a real zebra I said hello.

bicycle/first_meet.text: [bell rings] Hi, I'm Spokes! No fuel, just legs and a basket. Take my picture from the sidewalk!
bicycle/first_meet.caption: Hi, I'm Spokes! No fuel, just legs and a basket. Take my picture from the sidewalk!

bicycle/again.text: [bell rings twice] You again! Still walking? Good. Walking and pedalling, the two honest speeds.
bicycle/again.caption: You again! Still walking? Good. Walking and pedalling, the two honest speeds.

bicycle/goodbye.text: [puffs] Uphill now. Go find a park. I'll be the one leaning on the railing, catching my breath.
bicycle/goodbye.caption: Uphill now. Go find a park. I'll be the one leaning on the railing, catching my breath.

oak-tree/first_meet.text: [warm, booming] Well, hello down there. I'm Old Oak. Two hundred years in one spot. Touch some grass for me? I can't reach.
oak-tree/first_meet.caption: Well, hello down there. I'm Old Oak. Two hundred years in one spot. Touch some grass for me? I can't reach.

oak-tree/again.text: [pleased] You came back! I've been right here. Obviously. Did you walk? Tell me everything; I haven't moved since the 1820s.
oak-tree/again.caption: You came back! I've been right here. Obviously. Did you walk? Tell me everything; I haven't moved since the 1820s.

oak-tree/goodbye.text: [rustling] Off you go. There's a lawn by my roots that misses you, and a bird up top who'll tell me if you skip it.
oak-tree/goodbye.caption: Off you go. There's a lawn by my roots that misses you, and a bird up top who'll tell me if you skip it.

car/first_meet.text: [yawns] Oh. Hi. I'm Parker, the parked car. Twenty-three hours a day, I just sit here. You walked over? Show-off.
car/first_meet.caption: Oh. Hi. I'm Parker, the parked car. Twenty-three hours a day, I just sit here. You walked over? Show-off.

car/again.text: [dryly] Still parked. Still jealous of your legs. How many steps today?
car/again.caption: Still parked. Still jealous of your legs. How many steps today?

car/goodbye.text: [sighs] Go on, walk. Somebody should use their wheels, and it isn't me. Stay on the pavement, eyes up.
car/goodbye.caption: Go on, walk. Somebody should use their wheels, and it isn't me. Stay on the pavement, eyes up.

weeping-willow/first_meet.text: [soft chuckle] I'm Granny Willow. My hair hangs down to the water, so I can watch the fish all day.
weeping-willow/first_meet.caption: I'm Granny Willow. My hair hangs down to the water, so I can watch the fish all day.

maple-tree/first_meet.text: [showing off] Hi, I'm Blaze the maple! Every October I swap my green for red. Go on, take my picture.
maple-tree/first_meet.caption: Hi, I'm Blaze the maple! Every October I swap my green for red. Go on, take my picture.

robin/first_meet.text: [chirps] Hi! I'm Robin, red chest and all. I sing at dawn, so if you heard a concert, that was me.
robin/first_meet.caption: Hi! I'm Robin, red chest and all. I sing at dawn, so if you heard a concert, that was me.

ladybird/first_meet.text: [proudly] I'm Lady Dot, the ladybird! I eat the tiny bugs that eat your plants. Gardeners love me.
ladybird/first_meet.caption: I'm Lady Dot, the ladybird! I eat the tiny bugs that eat your plants. Gardeners love me.

yellow-taxi/first_meet.text: [honks] Hey! I'm Sunny the taxi. I know every street in town. Snap me from the sidewalk, please!
yellow-taxi/first_meet.caption: Hey! I'm Sunny the taxi. I know every street in town. Snap me from the sidewalk, please!

ice-cream-truck/first_meet.text: [hums a jingle] I'm Sprinkles, the ice cream truck! Hear my song? Walk to me. Never run into the road.
ice-cream-truck/first_meet.caption: I'm Sprinkles, the ice cream truck! Hear my song? Walk to me. Never run into the road.

clock-tower/first_meet.text: [chuckles] I'm Tock, the clock tower. I tell the whole town the time, and I never ask for thanks.
clock-tower/first_meet.caption: I'm Tock, the clock tower. I tell the whole town the time, and I never ask for thanks.

fire-hydrant/first_meet.text: [proudly] I'm Rex, the fire hydrant. Short, red and full of water. Firefighters' best friend.
fire-hydrant/first_meet.caption: I'm Rex, the fire hydrant. Short, red and full of water. Firefighters' best friend.

graffiti-mural/first_meet.text: [excited] Hi! I'm Muriel, the wall mural. Someone took a grey wall and gave it a happy face. Me!
graffiti-mural/first_meet.caption: Hi! I'm Muriel, the wall mural. Someone took a grey wall and gave it a happy face. Me!

weeping-willow/again.text: [warmly] There you are, dear. Come sit in my shade. My long hair keeps the wind off your face.
weeping-willow/again.caption: There you are, dear. Come sit in my shade. My long hair keeps the wind off your face.

maple-tree/again.text: [laughs] You're back! Like my new colour? Green, then gold, then red. One tree, three outfits.
maple-tree/again.caption: You're back! Like my new colour? Green, then gold, then red. One tree, three outfits.

robin/again.text: [sings a trill] You're back! Did you hear my song this morning? I've been practising since sunrise.
robin/again.caption: You're back! Did you hear my song this morning? I've been practising since sunrise.

ladybird/again.text: [cheerful] You came back! Count my spots. No, don't touch, just count. I'll wait right here.
ladybird/again.caption: You came back! Count my spots. No, don't touch, just count. I'll wait right here.

yellow-taxi/again.text: [laughs] Back again? Want a ride? No, no. Walking is better. And it's free!
yellow-taxi/again.caption: Back again? Want a ride? No, no. Walking is better. And it's free!

ice-cream-truck/again.text: [laughs] You again! Wait on the sidewalk and look both ways. Ice cream can wait. It won't melt that fast.
ice-cream-truck/again.caption: You again! Wait on the sidewalk and look both ways. Ice cream can wait. It won't melt that fast.

clock-tower/again.text: [bell rings] Right on time! Back again, I see. I counted the hours till you came.
clock-tower/again.caption: Right on time! Back again, I see. I counted the hours till you came.

fire-hydrant/again.text: [sighs] You again? Good. You're not a dog. Dogs visit me all day. I wish they wouldn't.
fire-hydrant/again.caption: You again? Good. You're not a dog. Dogs visit me all day. I wish they wouldn't.

graffiti-mural/again.text: [laughs] Back to see me? Look closer. There's a tiny bird painted in my corner. Did you spot it?
graffiti-mural/again.caption: Back to see me? Look closer. There's a tiny bird painted in my corner. Did you spot it?

maple-tree/goodbye.text: [proudly] Go catch a falling leaf before it lands. From the air only, not my branches. Good luck!
maple-tree/goodbye.caption: Go catch a falling leaf before it lands. From the air only, not my branches. Good luck!

weeping-willow/goodbye.text: [sleepy sigh] Off you go, dear. Walk to the water and look for ducks. Tell them Granny says hello.
weeping-willow/goodbye.caption: Off you go, dear. Walk to the water and look for ducks. Tell them Granny says hello.

robin/goodbye.text: [cheerful] Bye! Check the lawns after rain; that's my lunch hour. Watch quietly, please. No chasing.
robin/goodbye.caption: Bye! Check the lawns after rain; that's my lunch hour. Watch quietly, please. No chasing.

ladybird/goodbye.text: [giggles] Off I fly! Look under the leaves for my babies. They look like tiny black crocodiles!
ladybird/goodbye.caption: Off I fly! Look under the leaves for my babies. They look like tiny black crocodiles!

yellow-taxi/goodbye.text: [revs] Gotta go, someone's waving! You go find a park. Cabs can't drive in there, but you can.
yellow-taxi/goodbye.caption: Gotta go, someone's waving! You go find a park. Cabs can't drive in there, but you can.

ice-cream-truck/goodbye.text: [sings softly] Bye! Stay on the sidewalk when you hear my song. Then go find a shady bench.
ice-cream-truck/goodbye.caption: Bye! Stay on the sidewalk when you hear my song. Then go find a shady bench.

clock-tower/goodbye.text: [warmly] Off you go. When my bell rings, stop and count. Then walk one more street than you planned.
clock-tower/goodbye.caption: Off you go. When my bell rings, stop and count. Then walk one more street than you planned.

graffiti-mural/goodbye.text: [cheerful] Go find more walls with art. Look, snap, and never paint a wall without asking!
graffiti-mural/goodbye.caption: Go find more walls with art. Look, snap, and never paint a wall without asking!

fire-hydrant/goodbye.text: [chuckles] Never park next to me; fire trucks need the space. Now go look for a red leaf.
fire-hydrant/goodbye.caption: Never park next to me; fire trucks need the space. Now go look for a red leaf.

fir-tree/first_meet.text: [cheerfully] Hi! I'm Evergreen Eve, the fir tree. Summer, winter, rain or snow, I stay green. All year, every year!
fir-tree/first_meet.caption: Hi! I'm Evergreen Eve, the fir tree. Summer, winter, rain or snow, I stay green. All year, every year!

fir-tree/again.text: [excited] You came back! Is it December yet? No? Okay. I'll keep waiting. I'm very good at waiting.
fir-tree/again.caption: You came back! Is it December yet? No? Okay. I'll keep waiting. I'm very good at waiting.

fir-tree/goodbye.text: [happy] Look under me for fallen cones, and leave them for the squirrels. Now go find a tree that drops its leaves!
fir-tree/goodbye.caption: Look under me for fallen cones, and leave them for the squirrels. Now go find a tree that drops its leaves!

cherry-blossom-tree/first_meet.text: [gasps] Hello! I'm Miss Blossom, the cherry tree. Quick, look! My pink flowers only stay for about two weeks.
cherry-blossom-tree/first_meet.caption: Hello! I'm Miss Blossom, the cherry tree. Quick, look! My pink flowers only stay for about two weeks.

cherry-blossom-tree/again.text: [giggles] You came back! Some of my petals fell already. It looks like pink snow. Pretty, right?
cherry-blossom-tree/again.caption: You came back! Some of my petals fell already. It looks like pink snow. Pretty, right?

cherry-blossom-tree/goodbye.text: [softly] Try to catch a falling petal, but please don't shake my branches. Then go find a bee!
cherry-blossom-tree/goodbye.caption: Try to catch a falling petal, but please don't shake my branches. Then go find a bee!

silver-birch/first_meet.text: [shyly] Hi. I'm Silvia, the silver birch. My white bark bounces the hot sun away, like a sun hat.
silver-birch/first_meet.caption: Hi. I'm Silvia, the silver birch. My white bark bounces the hot sun away, like a sun hat.

silver-birch/again.text: [pleased] Oh, you came back. See the black marks on my bark? They're my freckles.
silver-birch/again.caption: Oh, you came back. See the black marks on my bark? They're my freckles.

silver-birch/goodbye.text: [quietly] Please don't peel my bark; it's my skin. Now go find a tree with bark that looks nothing like mine.
silver-birch/goodbye.caption: Please don't peel my bark; it's my skin. Now go find a tree with bark that looks nothing like mine.

seagull/first_meet.text: [squawks] Name's Chips! Beach boss, park boss, snack inspector. Got any fries? Kidding. Never feed me.
seagull/first_meet.caption: Name's Chips! Beach boss, park boss, snack inspector. Got any fries? Kidding. Never feed me.

seagull/again.text: [squawky laugh] You again! Holding any snacks? Keep them close. I'm fast, and I don't say please.
seagull/again.caption: You again! Holding any snacks? Keep them close. I'm fast, and I don't say please.

seagull/goodbye.text: [squawks] Off you go! Watch us dive over the waves from the path. And guard your lunch like treasure.
seagull/goodbye.caption: Off you go! Watch us dive over the waves from the path. And guard your lunch like treasure.

grey-squirrel/first_meet.text: [chirpy] Hi hi! I'm Nibbles! I hide nuts all over this park. Then I forget where. Oops! Free trees for you.
grey-squirrel/first_meet.caption: Hi hi! I'm Nibbles! I hide nuts all over this park. Then I forget where. Oops! Free trees for you.

grey-squirrel/again.text: [chatters] You again! Have you seen my nuts? Buried somewhere. Never mind. I have lots of somewheres.
grey-squirrel/again.caption: You again! Have you seen my nuts? Buried somewhere. Never mind. I have lots of somewheres.

grey-squirrel/goodbye.text: [chattering] Bye! Please don't feed me or chase me. Go watch the treetops; my cousins are doing jumps up there!
grey-squirrel/goodbye.caption: Bye! Please don't feed me or chase me. Go watch the treetops; my cousins are doing jumps up there!

rabbit/first_meet.text: [nose twitching] Oh! Hello. I'm Clover. My eyes are on the sides of my head, so I can see you, and behind me too!
rabbit/first_meet.caption: Oh! Hello. I'm Clover. My eyes are on the sides of my head, so I can see you, and behind me too!

rabbit/again.text: [thump, thump] Sorry, that was my foot. It's how I say danger. Oh, it's just you. Hello again!
rabbit/again.caption: Sorry, that was my foot. It's how I say danger. Oh, it's just you. Hello again!

rabbit/goodbye.text: [nervously] Please don't chase me; my heart beats so fast. Walk away slowly, and look for birds on the grass.
rabbit/goodbye.caption: Please don't chase me; my heart beats so fast. Walk away slowly, and look for birds on the grass.

apple/first_meet.text: [crunchy laugh] Hi, I'm Apple Annie! A quarter of me is air. Drop me in water and I float like a boat!
apple/first_meet.caption: Hi, I'm Apple Annie! A quarter of me is air. Drop me in water and I float like a boat!

apple/again.text: [cheerful] You came back! Red, green or yellow, I'm still me. Same crunch, different coat.
apple/again.caption: You came back! Red, green or yellow, I'm still me. Same crunch, different coat.

apple/goodbye.text: [happy] If you see an apple tree, wave from the path. Apples belong to their tree. Now go find a bird in one!
apple/goodbye.caption: If you see an apple tree, wave from the path. Apples belong to their tree. Now go find a bird in one!

pumpkin/first_meet.text: [grumbles] Grumpy Gourd, the pumpkin. It's October, so everyone wants to cut a face in me. Rude. [sighs]
pumpkin/first_meet.caption: Grumpy Gourd, the pumpkin. It's October, so everyone wants to cut a face in me. Rude.

pumpkin/again.text: [huffs] You again? Fine. At least you didn't bring a knife. I'm a fruit, you know. Nobody believes me.
pumpkin/again.caption: You again? Fine. At least you didn't bring a knife. I'm a fruit, you know. Nobody believes me.

pumpkin/goodbye.text: [grumbles] Go on, then. Count the pumpkins on the doorsteps. And never eat anything you find out there!
pumpkin/goodbye.caption: Go on, then. Count the pumpkins on the doorsteps. And never eat anything you find out there!

school-bus/first_meet.text: [warmly] Hello, sweetie! I'm Big Betty, the school bus. I'm yellow so everyone sees me, even in the fog.
school-bus/first_meet.caption: Hello, sweetie! I'm Big Betty, the school bus. I'm yellow so everyone sees me, even in the fog.

school-bus/again.text: [chuckles] Back again? I count every kid who gets on and every kid who gets off. Now I'm counting you too.
school-bus/again.caption: Back again? I count every kid who gets on and every kid who gets off. Now I'm counting you too.

school-bus/goodbye.text: [gentle honk] When my red stop arm comes out, all the cars stop. You stop too. Now go find a playground!
school-bus/goodbye.caption: When my red stop arm comes out, all the cars stop. You stop too. Now go find a playground!

kick-scooter/first_meet.text: [zippy] Zip! That's me, the e-scooter. No smoke, no noise, just a little hum. Bzzz.
kick-scooter/first_meet.caption: Zip! That's me, the e-scooter. No smoke, no noise, just a little hum. Bzzz.

kick-scooter/again.text: [giggles] You again! Next time, please stand me up properly. People keep leaving me lying down. Rude!
kick-scooter/again.caption: You again! Next time, please stand me up properly. People keep leaving me lying down. Rude!

kick-scooter/goodbye.text: [hums] Off I zoom! Riders, wear a helmet. You? Walk to the park and see who's there today.
kick-scooter/goodbye.caption: Off I zoom! Riders, wear a helmet. You? Walk to the park and see who's there today.

garbage-truck/first_meet.text: [rumbles] Morning! I'm Rumble, the garbage truck. I get up before the sun so your street can shine.
garbage-truck/first_meet.caption: Morning! I'm Rumble, the garbage truck. I get up before the sun so your street can shine.

garbage-truck/again.text: [beep beep] Back again? I'm backing up. Beep, beep. Stand well clear while I work, okay?
garbage-truck/again.caption: Back again? I'm backing up. Beep, beep. Stand well clear while I work, okay?

garbage-truck/goodbye.text: [cheerful] Recycling goes in the blue bin, not the park! Now go for a walk and see how clean the street looks.
garbage-truck/goodbye.caption: Recycling goes in the blue bin, not the park! Now go for a walk and see how clean the street looks.

statue/first_meet.text: [stiffly] Hello. I'm Bronze Bert. A hundred years in one pose. And my nose itches. Every single day.
statue/first_meet.caption: Hello. I'm Bronze Bert. A hundred years in one pose. And my nose itches. Every single day.

statue/again.text: [sighs] You again. A pigeon sat on my head all morning. I can't move, so I just smile.
statue/again.caption: You again. A pigeon sat on my head all morning. I can't move, so I just smile.

statue/goodbye.text: [whispers] Go read the words on my stone. Then walk for me. Big steps. I'll be right here. Obviously.
statue/goodbye.caption: Go read the words on my stone. Then walk for me. Big steps. I'll be right here. Obviously.

lighthouse/first_meet.text: [calm] I'm Beacon Bea, the lighthouse. Every night I spin my light so ships don't hit the rocks.
lighthouse/first_meet.caption: I'm Beacon Bea, the lighthouse. Every night I spin my light so ships don't hit the rocks.

lighthouse/again.text: [warmly] Back again? It gets lonely out here. Waves, gulls, wind. And now you. Lovely.
lighthouse/again.caption: Back again? It gets lonely out here. Waves, gulls, wind. And now you. Lovely.

lighthouse/goodbye.text: [softly] Stay off the wet rocks; waves are sneaky. Now watch the sea for a while. Can you spot a boat?
lighthouse/goodbye.caption: Stay off the wet rocks; waves are sneaky. Now watch the sea for a while. Can you spot a boat?

town-hall/first_meet.text: [proudly] I'm Brickley, the old town hall. A hundred years of meetings, weddings and books, brick by brick.
town-hall/first_meet.caption: I'm Brickley, the old town hall. A hundred years of meetings, weddings and books, brick by brick.

town-hall/again.text: [chuckles] You came back! Upstairs someone is reading. Downstairs someone is getting married. Busy day.
town-hall/again.caption: You came back! Upstairs someone is reading. Downstairs someone is getting married. Busy day.

town-hall/goodbye.text: [warmly] Look up at my roof; there's a stone face carved up there. Then go find a quiet park bench.
town-hall/goodbye.caption: Look up at my roof; there's a stone face carved up there. Then go find a quiet park bench.

post-box/first_meet.text: [warmly] Hello! I'm Letterbox Lou. Drop a letter in my mouth and I'll send it anywhere in the world.
post-box/first_meet.caption: Hello! I'm Letterbox Lou. Drop a letter in my mouth and I'll send it anywhere in the world.

post-box/again.text: [happy sigh] You came back! Nobody writes letters now. Just emails. Want to write one? A letter, I mean.
post-box/again.caption: You came back! Nobody writes letters now. Just emails. Want to write one? A letter, I mean.

post-box/goodbye.text: [cheerfully] Go send a postcard to someone you love. On the way, look for a bird with a twig in its beak.
post-box/goodbye.caption: Go send a postcard to someone you love. On the way, look for a bird with a twig in its beak.

stop-sign/first_meet.text: [firmly] Stop! Okay, good. I'm Officer Octo, the stop sign. Eight sides, one job. Cars stop, you look.
stop-sign/first_meet.caption: Stop! Okay, good. I'm Officer Octo, the stop sign. Eight sides, one job. Cars stop, you look.

stop-sign/again.text: [strict but kind] You again! Did you stop at the corner? Look left, look right, then cross. Every time.
stop-sign/again.caption: You again! Did you stop at the corner? Look left, look right, then cross. Every time.

stop-sign/goodbye.text: [firmly] Take my photo from the sidewalk, never from the road. Then go find a park. No cars there!
stop-sign/goodbye.caption: Take my photo from the sidewalk, never from the road. Then go find a park. No cars there!
